header.description: FAM-13 character side: SetupMonsterAttackSimWithCharStats, CalculateMonsterDamageVsChar (solo and party), GetPreCalculatedMonsterDamage and GetMonsterAvgDmgFromDB (stock engine) over stock monsters.
notes: Characters: the control values (AC, DR, MR, dodge, anti-magic, protection from evil, resist tags) of pipeline fixture cases, copied as literals; 'characters' maps each label to its pipeline case id. s_* characters have hand-written controls.

The damage arrays nMonsterDamageVsChar/Party/Default are dimensioned to the highest monster number and -1 in the setup, as ClearMonsterDamageVsCharALL leaves them; GetPreCalculatedMonsterDamage reads back what CalculateMonsterDamageVsChar stored.
Random mode (bDynamic False) on the oracle's seeded Rnd; the final Rnd state is read so the sequence of rolls is pinned.

table (top-level key, ignored by the oracle) holds the rows the Rust test builds its World from: monsters [Number, Align, Energy, Weapon, [5 x [AttName, AttType, AttAcc, Att%, AttTrue%, AttMin, AttMax, AttEnergy, AttHitSpell]], [5 x [MidSpell, MidSpell%, MidSpellLVL]], [[DropItem, DropItem%]..], DeathSpell, AvgDmg]; spells and items as in monster_glue.json.
